    Edge(int u_, int v_, int f_, int c_) : u(u_), v(v_), flow(f_), cap(c_) {}
};

class Dinic {
public:
    int S, T;
    vector<vector<int>> g;
    vector<Edge> e;
    vector<int> ptr, level;

    Dinic(int n, int s, int t) : S(s), T(t), g(n), ptr(n), level(n) {}

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        g[u].push_back((int)e.size());
        e.push_back(Edge(u, v, 0, c));
        g[v].push_back((int)e.size());
        e.push_back(Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
    }

    bool bfs() {
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        level[S] = 0;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(S);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int id : g[u]) {
                int v = e[id].v;
                if (level[v] == -1 && e[id].flow < e[id].cap) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.push(v);
                    if (v == T) return true;

            }
        }
        return 0;

        }
        return ans;

bool bfs() {
    fill(distLevel.begin(), distLevel.end(), -1);
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(src);
    distLevel[src] = 0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (int e = headEdge[u]; e != -1; e = nextEdge[e]) {
            int v = toNode[e];
            if (distLevel[v] == -1 && edgeCap[e] > 0) {
                distLevel[v] = distLevel[u] + 1;
                q.push(v);
                if (v == sink) return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

long long dfs(int u, int f) {
    if (f == 0) return 0;
    if (u == sink) return f;
    for (int &e = current[u]; e != -1; e = nextEdge[e]) {
        int v = toNode[e];
        if (distLevel[v] != distLevel[u] + 1 || edgeCap[e] == 0) continue;
        long long pushed = dfs(v, min(f, edgeCap[e]));
        if (pushed) {
            edgeCap[e] -= (int)pushed;
            edgeCap[e ^ 1] += (int)pushed;
            return pushed;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

long long maxflow() {
    long long ans = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        current = headEdge;
        while (long long pushed = dfs(src, INF)) ans += pushed;
    }
    return ans;
}
